name: Wick Liquidation
hook: Dodge the red cascading candles before your long position gets vaporized
tagline: Ride a tiny bull surfing on a monstrous red descending candlestick as liquidation bells chime. Cash out to eject into a golden parachute safely holding bags of stablecoins. If you linger too long, the ultimate cascade margin call hammers down into a total portfolio flatline.
